method.pilot: one parent-only 500k-trip run per loaded profile; freeze counts targeting 6s min(CPU,wall), cap10M before paired measurements
method.cpu_scope: server lifetime including setup, warm-up, probes and resource inspection
method.rss_scope: loaded is post-throughput retained RSS; peak is separate 50ms sampled process RSS, excludes kernel memory
method.scope: same-runner loopback; closed-loop loaded comparisons plus bounded fixed-schedule sparse probe, not WAN capacity or bare-metal isolation

host.cpu_timer: os.wait4 rusage user+system seconds, microsecond fields; stored to six decimals
